note: The HEAD SHAPE TABLE, drawn. One ruler per look, ON TARGET (a ControlNet does not carry the unconditioned generator's bias, and the head carries no measured bias anyway). Every ruler is on the contract's head canvas at the contract's seat, keeps the apex row so the figure's H does not move, carries exactly two lamp eyes on the design-one eye row at the design-one radius band, a blank forehead, the crease lugs and the contract's own dome underside, and keeps its ink inside the full head width. Nothing here is shipped and the game never reads this folder. The canvases and pivots are the frozen contract in src/app/bots/_view/rig-points.ts, unchanged. The table is scripts/bots-shapes.json; the drawing is headPartsV3 in this file.

looks.name: Round
looks.prompt: a rounded dome crown with a round cup ear high on each side
looks.mouthPrompt: a dark recessed curved smile for a mouth, low on the face under the eyes
looks.notes: the shipped design-one head. Its crown is the baseline every other shape is a departure from, so it is in the table with its two new mouths and its own grille look is left alone.
